products.descriptionEn: Evidence-first Company Brain on your stack. The whole team asks in Element and gets confirmed facts back — ingest of channels is the other direction, not the product. A thin tool-calling agent — local Qwen + PicoClaw, currently in debug — reaches the brain over MCP: search → get → audit. We do not claim an air-gapped production install at a partner.
